tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Refer Tender documents for detailed criteria, terms and conditions
The bidders should upload only scanned original documents (in coloured) to the KPP Portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: KPTCL at its discretion, may conduct type tests and/or additional type tests as per technical specifications of the subject tender conducted as per the relevant IS/IEC standards at its cost, on a randomly selected material by KPTCL officials, at any point of time during the contract at CPRI Laboratory. In case KPTCL opts for conducting type tests and/or additional type tests at CPRI on the randomly selected materials, the same will be conducted at KPTCLs cost. Applicable testing charges of CPRI shall be paid by the successful bidder upfront and the same is reimbursable by the KPTCL as per actual, on submission of bills along with proof of payment, on successful passing of tests. However, the transportation and insurance charges shall be borne by the supplier himself. In case of failure of material during testing, the material will not be accepted by KPTCL and KPTCL will not reimburse the testing charges of CPRI to the laboratory. Further, the order placed on the Firm will be cancelled and the performance Bank Guarantee will be forfeited and Tenderer will be de-barred from participating in KPTCL tenders for a period of 1 year. For all the materials already supplied, the Tenderer shall furnish an additional two years guarantee and shall extend the validity of Performance Bank Guarantee accordingly. Tenderer shall upload an undertaking agreeing to above criteria and to bear transportation and insurance charges. Declaration in the firms letter head to be provided.
